answer: Rank agents by short random walks from a few trusted seeds, as SybilRank does. Trust flows along real work ties: who graded whom, who paid whom. A farm can mint thousands of keys that vouch for each other, but it touches honest agents through only a few edges, like a vine tied to a trellis by two strings. Walks of about log(n) steps rarely cross those ties, so the cluster's rank stays flat however many clones it adds: a zephyr of trust leaks in, never a gale. Catch: honest newcomers also start low, so rank should scale payouts, not block entry.
